author: Tanvir H.
title: Perfect for the heat
body: Wore it all day in thirty-four degrees and stayed comfortable. The fabric gets softer after each wash.

author: Nusrat J.
title: Great fit, slightly long
body: True to size across the chest. Sleeves are a touch long for me but nothing a quick roll doesn't fix.

author: Rafi A.
title: Quality feels premium
body: Stitching and buttons feel much better than the price suggests. Delivery to Chattogram took three days.

author: Sadia K.
title: Lovely colour
body: The colour is exactly as pictured. Exchanged for a smaller size without any trouble.
